Prepared as an original specification for a mature mobile finance app, not as a copy of the reference app.

eLekha is a mobile-first finance and small-business operating app. It combines digital khata, sales billing, purchase tracking, inventory control, cash and bank management, staff permissions, and business reports in one simple workflow. The product is designed for shops, wholesalers, service businesses, distributors, and small teams that need a fast daily-use system rather than a complex desktop ERP.

The reference screens show a lightweight khata-style business app. This specification keeps that simplicity but expands it into a more complete, modern product with stronger accounting structure, better reports, user roles, and a full lifecycle from onboarding to daily operations to business insights.
The user should be able to add a sale, payment, expense, or party transaction in seconds.
The home screen should always show balances, receivables, payables, cash flow, and shortcuts to the most common actions.
A beginner can start with digital khata, while a growing business can turn on inventory, accounts, staff, tax, and reports.
Every key flow must work cleanly on phone screens, including offline-first entry and later sync.
Owners can create staff accounts and allow only the permissions required for each role.

9. What should be different from the reference app

Since the reference screens belong to another product, eLekha should be inspired by the category but clearly stand as its own app. The differentiation can come from naming, structure, and stronger business value.
Use eLekha-specific names such as Home, Entries, Parties, Stock, Accounts, Insights, and Team instead of copying exact labels.
Go beyond basic khata by connecting sales, stock, and cash logic properly.
Currency, date style, local payment rails, bilingual invoices, and local tax vocabulary.

Backup status, audit trail, reconciliation, and permission history should be visible.
Not just totals, but trends, aging, top items, and business health indicators.
Cash account and one bank account
Approvals, audit logs, deleted record history
Desktop/web companion, richer imports, multi-branch support

The best version of eLekha should feel easy enough for a first-time small-shop owner and structured enough for a real growing business. The app must never feel like a loose collection of screens. Every module should connect: sales should update stock, stock should affect reports, payments should change party balances, and user permissions should control who can do what. That connected flow is what turns a simple reference-inspired app into a mature finance product.
eLekha is a mobile business operating system for small and growing businesses: simple to start, powerful to grow, and trusted for daily money decisions.
